summary: chore(shared): move Glean YAML and generated web code out of fxa-shared
description:
Because:

* The FxA Glean YAML already lives in libs/shared/metrics/glean
* Only fxa-settings uses the generated Glean web code

This commit:

* Removes the Glean YAML and pair-reasons.ts from fxa-shared
* Moves the generated web code into fxa-settings src/lib/glean/web
* Points the glean scripts of auth, content and settings at the registry
* Runs glean-lint in the fxa-settings lint script

Closes FXA-14711
